title: CBD Inhaler Social Media
description: A material experiment and social media graphic design piece for the Well-Beings CBD Inhaler. The primary challenge was working within Instagram's 1:1 format to create advertising images that engage the viewer.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: Material experiments and social media graphics for the Well-Beings CBD inhaler.

brief.label: Approach
brief.text: Each square stages the inhaler in its own surreal set, with clouds, mountains and smoke.

study_intro: Making a small product stop the scroll: surreal sets, soft pastels and the product as the only real object.

study.label: Color
study.text: Coral, mint and teal, matching the product's own branding.

study.label: Sets
study.text: Clouds, paper mountains, smoke and painted skies, each a different world for the same object.

study.label: Format
study.text: Built for Instagram's square, with the product placed to anchor every composition.
